lines.text: Upgrade your Chips to gain powerful buffs!
lines.zh: 升级芯片，获得强力增益!

lines.text: Sowdust is dropped from harvesting crops in The Garden and is used to upgrade the Chips you've unlocked!
lines.zh: 在花园收获作物可获得播尘，用于升级已解锁的芯片!
